title: aaas.expression.submitted.v1
description: Published by expression-assembler when the user presses `=`: the expression assembled from the key presses of a session, with the newly created taskId. Consumed by parser (to build the AST) and stopwatch (start of the official time, taken from occurredAt).

producer.description: The only service allowed to publish this event (contracts/events/topics.psv).

taskId.description: Addition task the event belongs to; never null for this event.

payload.description: The submitted expression and the session it was typed in.

sessionId.description: Identifier of the calculator session generated by the frontend (lowercase UUID of any version), as sent in the body of POST /api/v1/keys.

expression.description: Key presses of the session in order, from the last `C` (or the session start) up to the `=`, which is not included. Only digit keys and `+` occur; the syntax (exactly one `+` between two numbers) is checked by parser and the range by validator, so a malformed expression is still a valid event.
